messages:
Maya R: Quick weekly health check for Starlit (mid-onboard). Sharing token usage + throughput QoW / QoQ snapshot — flagged items below.

Maya R: TL;DR — tokens up 22% WoW, ingestion burst on Wed caused latency blip, spend +14% QoQ but still within committed band. No immediate renew risk, but enablement needed on prompt engineering. :bar_chart:

Jae K: Can you paste the numbers? curious about 99th pct latency and error rate during the Wed spike.

Maya R: Sure — snippet from telemetry:
```
Period       tokens/day   p50 lat   p95 lat   p99 lat   errors/day   est spend/day
Last week    1,420,000    80ms      210ms     560ms     12           $42.5
Prev week    1,165,000    76ms      190ms     140ms     4            $36.8
QoQ avg      1,250,000    74ms      180ms     130ms     3            $37.2
```
(Spike: Wed 14:30 UTC — sustained p99 ~560ms for ~12m)

Owen T: Looks like the p99 blip lines up with a model fallback event to the larger variant. We had an autoscale cold-start + a small cache miss window. I can correlate infra logs.

Priya S: Renewal contact in 8 weeks. Noting they are hitting committed tier but creeping toward burst overage. Suggest a short enablement session focused on batching and cache hints + a review of prompt shapes to reduce token churn.

Maya R: Agreed — propose 30m enablement next Tue. Agenda: prompt cost heuristics, prefix caching, recommended batch sizes. Also capture feedback: Starlit asked for clearer examples for system prompts + safe-fallback handling.

Jae K: +1. For ops: can you add a query to detect model fallback events for this customer so we can alert earlier? example: `SELECT count(*) FROM fallbacks WHERE customer='starlit' AND ts>now()-1d`

Owen T: Will add. Also uploading a short log extract here — shows fallback at 2025-11-12T14:29:34Z and autoscale start at 14:30:05Z. Cold-start latency ~18s, KV cache warmed at 14:41:00Z.

CS Bot: Billing alert: starlit usage hit 92% of monthly committed tokens threshold. Projected end-of-month utilization: 108% if current trend continues. (alert id: billing-2955-11)

Priya S: Flagging for renewal playbook: schedule enablement, confirm any PO/contract constraints, and see if we can offer a short burst buffer for peak hour at discounted rate to avoid surprise overage.

Maya R: I'll send a short summary to Starlit CSM and propose Tue 09:30 PT. Also capturing action items: 1) Owen to add fallback detection + log attach (ETA EOD), 2) Jae to prepare sample prompt tuning doc (ETA Mon), 3) Maya to schedule enablement and update renewal tracker.

Owen T: Done — fallback alert rule created, testing on staging triggers OK.

Jae K: Drafting prompt tuning doc now, will post as a thread reply when ready.

Maya R: Great — thanks team. I'll update the renewal risk as "monitoring" in the tracker and escalate if projected spend > committed. :eyes:

Priya S: Also, capture customer feedback note: they asked for more examples of function-calling patterns for multi-turn prompts. I'll add to enablement deck.

Maya R: End of thread — will ping when enablement is scheduled.
